text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O asked me to join her for dance practice, so I followed her, and—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, everyone!
Shall we begin dance practice?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes! I saw it on TV yesterday! The parade here is famous for its flawless execution!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Flawless... which means, excellent! As an honor student,
I intend to learn from this thoroughly!
choice_data_list: I see, so it’s about learning…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Oops! Time really flew while we were chatting!
Let's hurry and get ready, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
First, let's buy some penlights!
I heard waving them makes the parade look much more refined.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Oh! Look over there, churros and soda!
Apparently those are must-haves too, so let's buy some!"
choice_data_list: T-This really is just practice, right?
T-This really is just practice, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Of course! These are all strategies straight from TV
to discover the true essence of a parade!
And so, with preparations complete, the parade finally began—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the Carrot King and Queen make their entrance—
...Oh... Ohhh... Ohhhhhh!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: T-That was an amazing dance... I got so excited, I accidentally crushed my penlight...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That expressiveness that rouses the crowd to this degree!
I must master it... and bask in the applause!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
—Whoops, ah?! Over there... is that
Carrot King and Quee—no, our Masters!
choice_data_list: So it's a greeting attraction, huh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
S-Should I ask directly!?
About the very essence of that dance!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I see! Experience is the best teacher! Well then, let's start dancing right away!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Strike while the iron is hot, or whatever they say...
Or rather, before I completely forget about it!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Do this! And this!
Like this... and like that............ Whoaa!?

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text: Wah! Big sis, do your best!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Kuh! Thank you so much for the cheers!
I'll definitely make it work next time!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Soiya! Seiya!
Soi-soi, sei-sei... Hoooohhh!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? That's the parade dance!
She copied it perfectly! That's aweeeesome!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!
What magnificent applause! I'll give you even more!

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Staff
text_block_list.text:
What on earth is all this commotion... H-Hey, customer?!
What do you think you're doing?!

Although we got scolded for causing a commotion...
later on, the dance instructor happily reported
that the quality of the dancing had improved.

And so, together with Sakura Bakushin O,
we lined up in the queue for the greeting attraction...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's finally... HERE!! It's my turn!
Allow me to ask my Masters!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That parade earlier was incredible!
Please, teach me your dance secrets!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hm! That heart hand sign...
I see, put heart into every inch, right down to the fingertips and toes.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Next, pointing to your head... Oh! So that means
to deepen my understanding of the choreography and express it with everything I've got!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Which means, in short...!
...You're telling me that full-throttle Bakushin is the only way!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, all roads lead to Bakushin!
How careless of me to forget such a thing!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Masters, thank you so much!
I'll return to my roots and master dance to perfection!"

...I was worried about whether it was actually helpful,
but later on, the dance instructor happily reported
that their dancing had improved.
